title: Low-Margin Branch Points in Deterministic LLM Deliberation
abstract: arXiv:2611.00546v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deterministic multi-agent LLM deliberation can exactly re- play a fixed transcript, yet exact replay alone does not test local resistance to controlled internal interventions. Because each response becomes context for later agents, a changed greedy token can redirect a transcript-mediated execution. We present a white-box audit of this local failure mode in a five-agent committee under greedy decoding. We prospectively select low- and high-margin token positions, require exact no-op re- play, inject norm-relative residual displacements, and measure first transcript divergence within ten generated tokens. Low- margin positions are more branch-sensitive than high-margin controls, while matched margin-reducing gradient directions branch substantially more often than margin-increasing con- trols. We then continue selected realized branches through the committee to distinguish textual persistence from preference and final-decision changes

translated_title: 确定性大语言模型协商中的低裕度分支点
translated_abstract: 确定性的多智能体大语言模型（LLM）协商可以精确重放固定的对话记录，然而仅凭精确重放并不能测试系统对受控内部干预的局部抵抗能力。由于每个响应都会成为后续智能体的上下文，一个被改变的贪心解码词元可能会使经由对话记录介导的执行过程转向。我们针对这种局部失效模式，在贪心解码下的五智能体委员会中进行了白盒审计。我们前瞻性地选择低裕度和高裕度的词元位置，要求精确的无操作重放，注入范数相对的残差位移，并测量十个生成词元内的首次对话记录分歧。结果显示，低裕度位置比高裕度对照更具分支敏感性，而匹配的降低裕度的梯度方向比增加裕度的对照方向产生分支的频率显著更高。随后，我们将选定的已实现分支在委员会中继续传递，以区分文本层面改变的持续性与偏好及最终决策变化之间的差异。
tldr: 该论文通过白盒审计发现，在确定性多智能体LLM协商中，低裕度词元位置显著更易引发对话分支，且降低裕度的干预会大幅增加分支发生频率，从而揭示了多智能体LLM系统对内部局部扰动的脆弱性。
en_tdlr: Through white-box audits of a five-agent LLM committee, this paper demonstrates that low-margin token positions are significantly more branch-sensitive and margin-reducing interventions substantially increase branching frequency, revealing the local fragility of deterministic multi-agent LLM deliberation to controlled internal perturbations.
